title: Microsoft 365 Copilot connectors: people properties in custom connectors resolved to Microsoft Entra users
summary: Hold for unsupported descriptions of the mechanism: Microsoft documents people property types, but does not establish that choosing them enables the roadmap's identity resolution or that the Entra fields are optional. The categorical statement that the capability takes no actions also exceeds the evidence. The roadmap facts, licensing and principal admin controls are supported.

claims.where: title; summary; What's changing; Why it matters
claims.claim: Microsoft plans simplified resolution of third-party emails or user IDs to corresponding Microsoft Entra identities.
claims.quote: This feature enables connectors to resolve external identities—such as email addresses or user IDs from third-party data sources—to their corresponding Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) identities.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes simpler integration without complex Graph API lookups.
claims.quote: Simplify integration workflows without needing complex Graph API lookups.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes avoiding strict dependency on object IDs.
claims.quote: Reduce setup friction by avoiding strict dependency on object IDs.

claims.claim: The planned improvement is better Copilot search and chat relevance through accurate people attribution.
claims.quote: Improve search and chat relevance in Copilot by ensuring accurate people attribution across connected systems.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn does not describe this roadmap item by name.
claims.quote: Searched: "Simplified People Resolution" "custom" Copilot connectors. Read principal, property, manage-connector and people-data build pages; no page identifies this roadmap item by name.

claims.claim: The principal type adds people-related properties to items indexed by an externalConnection.
claims.quote: Represents a complex data type used to add people-related properties to items indexed by an externalConnection.

claims.claim: principalCollection is the corresponding type for a list of people.
claims.quote: Use this datatype when the property refers to a list of people. Example: Contributors property for a GitHub PR where there can be multiple people.

claims.claim: A principal's externalId can be an email associated with the person in the external source.
claims.quote: The ID associated with the person in the external data source. It could also be an email associated with the person on the external source.

claims.claim: principal has entraId, email and upn fields.
claims.quote: "entraId": "String", "email": "String", "upn": "String"

claims.where: What's changing: optional entraId, email and upn
claims.claim: The entraId, email and upn fields are optional.
claims.quote: Searched: "principal" "externalId" "optional" Copilot connector resolution. Read the full v1.0 principal and property references: principal lists these fields but does not state their optionality; search returned no passage establishing it.
claims.fix: Remove 'optional' from 'alongside optional entraId, email and upn fields'. The principal reference at https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/api/resources/externalconnectors-principal?view=graph-rest-1.0 lists the fields without stating which are required.

claims.claim: Using principal types instead of strings for people properties can improve Copilot Search or chat results.
claims.quote: Using principal or principalCollection type properties instead of a string or string collection for people related properties while ingesting ExternalItems can provide better and more relevant results in Copilot Search or chat.

claims.where: What's changing; controls[2].note; Governance controls; Scope
claims.claim: Custom connector developers choose principal or principalCollection as schema property types in the Graph API.
claims.quote: A schema property definition for a Microsoft Search connection. ... The data type of the property. The possible values are: ... principal, principalCollection, unknownFutureValue.

claims.where: Governance controls: property type that enables people resolution
claims.claim: The schema property type enables the roadmap's people resolution.
claims.quote: Searched: "Simplified People Resolution" "custom" Copilot connectors. Read principal, property and connector API references; none identifies these types as enabling automatic identity resolution.
claims.fix: Replace 'The property type that enables people resolution is set in the connector's schema by its developer' with 'The developer sets people property types in the connector schema; Microsoft has not identified these types as the implementation of the roadmap item.' This preserves the uncertainty already stated in Open questions.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented matching rules for externalId or email in this capability.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot connector principal externalId email matching rules existing string properties rollout automatically. Read principal and property; search results describe prebuilt-connector and people-data mapping, not matching rules for this capability.

claims.quote: Searched: Copilot connector principal externalId email matching rules existing string properties rollout automatically. Read roadmap, principal, property and schema management. None states rollout default or automatic string conversion; Copilot Visibility is a different control.

claims.claim: Access to an indexed connector item is governed by its ACL.
claims.quote: An access control entry for an item indexed by a Microsoft Search externalConnection. ... The access granted to the identity. The possible values are: grant, deny, unknownFutureValue.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The ACL reference identifies Microsoft Entra users by object ID.
claims.quote: For Microsoft Entra identities, value is set to the object identifier of the user, group or tenant for types user, group and everyone (and everyoneExceptGuests) respectively.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: No change to item permissions is documented for this capability.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot connectors simplified people resolution principal externalId email matching existing connections default audit admin switch licensing. Read roadmap, principal and ACL references and connector API overview; none announces a permission change for these people properties.

claims.claim: People properties can carry an external name, email and UPN on indexed items.
claims.quote: Represents a complex data type used to add people-related properties to items indexed by an externalConnection. ... externalName ... email ... upn

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure: withhold a whole connection
claims.claim: Copilot Visibility provides an admin-side way to withhold a whole connection.
claims.quote: When the visibility is off, the connector is excluded from all Copilot Search and Copilot Chat results and responses. ... without affecting declarative agents and their data.
claims.fix: Replace 'the per-connection Copilot Visibility toggle is the admin-side way to withhold a whole connection' with 'where offered, the per-connection Copilot Visibility toggle withholds the connection from Copilot Search and Copilot Chat, but does not affect declarative agents and their data'. This makes the limitation already given elsewhere clear in the exposure advice.

claims.claim: The capability labels indexed items and takes no actions.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot connector principal people resolution actions read-only external system. Read principal, connector API and overview excerpts: people metadata and read-only Chat by default are documented, not a categorical no-actions guarantee for this capability.
claims.fix: Replace 'No change: the capability labels indexed items and takes no actions' with 'The roadmap describes identity resolution and people attribution, not new actions.' Do not turn the absence of announced actions into a guarantee about the undocumented implementation.
